4 اخمد النَّارَ He allayed the flaming, or blazing, of the fire; leaving its embers unextinguished: (S, Msb, K:) or he extinguished the fire utterly. (Msb.) And اخمدتها الرِّيحُ The wind allayed its flaming, or blazing. (A.) ＝
-A2- (tropical:) He was, or became, still, or motionless, and silent. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
